command:
set -eo pipefail
source /opt/ros/${ROS_DISTRO:-humble}/setup.bash
source /opt/navlab_official_ws/install/setup.bash
export PYTHONPATH='/workspace':${PYTHONPATH:-}
export NAVLAB_OFFICIAL_SDF_ROOTS=/opt/navlab_official_ws/install/ardupilot_gazebo/share:/opt/navlab_official_ws/install/ardupilot_gz_description/share
export SDF_PATH=${NAVLAB_OFFICIAL_SDF_ROOTS}:${SDF_PATH:-}
export GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH=${NAVLAB_OFFICIAL_SDF_ROOTS}:${GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH:-}
mkdir -p '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/sitl/scripts'
cp '/workspace/docker/profiles/ahrs-set-origin.lua' '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/sitl/scripts/ahrs-set-origin.lua'
test -s '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/sitl/scripts/ahrs-set-origin.lua'
cd '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/sitl'
python3 -m navlab.sim.gazebo_sensor.benewake_tfmini_serial --virtual-serial-link '/tmp/navlab_benewake_tfmini' --log-file '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/runtime/logs/benewake_tfmini_serial.runtime.log' &
benewake_pid=$!
trap 'kill ${benewake_pid:-} 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 200); do [ -e '/tmp/navlab_benewake_tfmini' ] && break; sleep 0.05; done
test -e '/tmp/navlab_benewake_tfmini'

source /opt/ros/${ROS_DISTRO:-humble}/setup.bash && source ${OFFICIAL_WS:-/opt/navlab_official_ws}/install/setup.bash && exec python3 -m navlab.real.companion.nodes.external_nav --endpoint udpin:0.0.0.0:14553 --odom-topic /external_nav/odom --status-topic /mavlink_external_nav/status --rate-hz 20 --quality 100 --source-system 191 --use-fcu-roll-pitch --align-yaw-to-fcu --local-position-pose-topic /navlab/fcu/local_position_pose --max-local-position-age-ms 1000 --max-horizontal-speed-mps 0.25 --max-yaw-rate-radps 0.6 > '/workspace/artifacts/sim/exploration/20260630T004434.612996205Z/runtime/logs/mavlink_external_nav.runtime.log' 2>&1
